text:
olivia_marketing: Quick heads-up — I uploaded a draft for the Spring launch newsletter + 3-step nurture sequence. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/spring-launch-draft. Ask: feedback on subject lines, segment rules, and send cadence.

devon_growth: skimmed — looks good. prefer a 3-email nurture (launch, use-case story, product tips) vs 4 to avoid list fatigue.

samir_patel: +1 on 3. also recommend splitting recipients into two lanes: self-serve (trial signups, low ARR) and expansion (named accounts / high ARR). different CTAs.

maria.g: I wrote a few subject line variants — can we A/B test? my picks: "How teams cut LLM inference cost by 4x" vs "Ship LLM features with predictable latency". thoughts? :thinking_face:

natalie_sales: For inbound routing please ensure MQL tag includes source=newsletter_spring and assign to SDR pool A for high-intent (opens + clicked demo). If someone clicks pricing + >2 opens, flag as SDR priority.

campaign-bot: Preview scheduled: Thu 09:00 PST. Follow-ups: +1 at 72h to non-openers (subject alt). Seed list: product, growth, se-squad. Preview link: https://campaigns.redwood.com/preview/17721.

olivia_marketing: Segment rules draft (quick copy):
```
segment: newsletter_spring_v1
include if: (lead.source == "signup" OR lead.segment == "eng_blog_subscribers") AND last_activity > 30d
exclude if: unsubscribed OR lead.role == "recruiter"
```
Please sanity-check.

maria.g: I'll set up A/B with 20/80 split for subject lines and track opens -> click -> demo funnel.

samir_patel: For the expansion lane, change CTA to "Request dedicated capacity consult" and add a short case study link in email 2.

analytics-bot: Added UTM params and QA checks. Tracking tags: utm_campaign=spring_launch_2026, utm_medium=email. Will publish open/click dashboards post-send.

devon_growth: timeline check — final copy by Tue EOD, list prep Wed, send Thurs. Everyone okay? :thumbsup:

olivia_marketing: Agreed. I'll consolidate final copy and tag owners. Thanks all — if no objections by Tue 5pm I'll queue the send.
